items.stem: What has caused the thick clouds in the photos taken by NASA satellite?

choices.text: Ship traffic in the Atlantic.
Warm currents in the ocean.
Exhaust from cars in Europe.
Particles emitted by power plants.

items.stem: What do NASA officials think about the thick clouds?

choices.text: They need to be taken seriously.
They have a huge effect on fishery.
choices.zh: 它们对渔业有巨大影响。

choices.text: They might be causing trouble to air flights.
choices.zh: 它们可能给航班造成麻烦。

choices.text: They may be affecting the world's climate.
choices.zh: 它们可能正在影响世界气候。

items.stem: For what purpose did the staff at a supermarket in Melbourne sign a letter?

choices.text: To appeal for higher wages.
To demand better health care.
To call for a permanent security guard.
To dismiss the bad-tempered supervisor.

items.stem: What did the spokesman of the supermarket say regarding the employees' demand?

choices.text: It had already taken strong action.
choices.zh: 它已经采取了强有力的行动。

choices.text: It would put customers' needs first.
choices.zh: 它会把顾客的需求放在首位。

choices.text: It would take their appeal seriously.
choices.zh: 它会认真对待他们的呼吁。

choices.text: It was seeking help from the police.
choices.zh: 它正在向警方寻求帮助。

items.stem: What did drivers on the motorway to Warsaw find?

choices.text: The road was flooded.
The road was blocked.
The road was frozen with snow.
The road was covered with spilled gas.
choices.zh: 道路被洒出的汽油覆盖了。

items.stem: What does the report say about the accident?

choices.text: A truck plunged into a pool of liquid chocolate.
choices.zh: 一辆卡车坠入了液态巧克力池中。

choices.text: The heavy snow made driving very difficult.
choices.zh: 大雪使得驾驶非常困难。

choices.text: The truck driver dozed off while driving.
choices.zh: 卡车司机在驾驶时打瞌睡了。

choices.text: A truck hit a barrier and overturned.
choices.zh: 一辆卡车撞上护栏并侧翻了。

items.stem: What did the firefighters' representative tell the local TV?

choices.text: It was a long time before the cleanup was finished.
choices.zh: 清理工作过了很长时间才完成。

choices.text: It was a hard task to remove the spilled substance.
choices.zh: 清除洒出的物质是一项艰巨的任务。

choices.text: It was fortunate that no passenger got injured.
choices.zh: 幸运的是没有乘客受伤。

choices.text: It was difficult to contact the manufacturer.

items.stem: Why did the woman decide to go back to cash for payment?

choices.text: She wanted to save for a new phone.
choices.zh: 她想为一部新手机存钱。

choices.text: She found it much safer to use cash.
choices.zh: 她发现使用现金安全得多。

choices.text: She could enjoy discount with cash.
choices.zh: 她用现金可以享受折扣。

choices.text: She had been cheated using phone apps.
choices.zh: 她使用手机应用程序时被骗过。

items.stem: What happens when people use apps for payment according to the woman?

choices.text: They can save a lot more time and trouble.
choices.zh: 他们可以节省大量时间和麻烦。

choices.text: They find it less difficult to make purchases.
choices.zh: 他们发现购物不那么困难了。

choices.text: They derive greater pleasure from buying things.
choices.zh: 他们从购物中获得更大的乐趣。

choices.text: They are less aware of the value of their money.
choices.zh: 他们对自己金钱的价值不那么敏感。

items.stem: What might the man tend to buy with payment apps?

choices.text: More valuable items.
More non-essential things.
Everyday necessities.
Electronic devices.

items.stem: What does the man think of electronic payment?

choices.text: It can improve shopping efficiency.
It is altering the way of shopping.
It may lead to excessive spending.
It appeals more to younger people.
choices.zh: 它对年轻人更有吸引力。

items.stem: Why did the man call the woman?

choices.text: He wanted to order some wooden furniture.
choices.zh: 他想订购一些木制家具。

choices.text: He had to change the furniture delivery time.
choices.zh: 他不得不更改家具配送时间。

choices.text: He had a problem with the furniture delivered.
choices.zh: 他对配送的家具有问题。

choices.text: He wanted the furniture store to give him a refund.
choices.zh: 他想让家具店给他退款。

items.stem: What did the woman ask the man to do?

choices.text: Send the furniture back to the store.
Describe the furniture he received.
Collect the furniture he ordered.
Buy another brand of furniture.
choices.zh: 购买另一个品牌的家具。

items.stem: What did the woman promise to do for the man?

choices.text: Correct their mistake.
Improve their service.
Apologize to his wife.
Give the money back.

items.stem: What did the woman do at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: She recommended a new style.
She offered some gift to the man.
choices.zh: 她给男士提供了一些礼品。

choices.text: She apologized to the man once more.
She checked all the items with the man.
choices.zh: 她和男士核对了所有物品。

items.stem: What is Marie Kondo's TV show about?

choices.text: Reading books of wisdom.
Tidying up one's home.
Sharing with others.
Donating to charity.

items.stem: What things can be kept in one's home according to Marie Kondo?

choices.text: Things that make one happy.
Things that are becoming rare.
Things that occupy little space.
Things that cost a lot of money.

items.stem: What do we learn about one used bookstore this January?

choices.text: It joined the city's clean-up campaign.
choices.zh: 它加入了该市的清理运动。

choices.text: It sold as many as fifty boxes of books.
choices.zh: 它售出了多达五十箱书。

choices.text: It received an incredibly large number of donated books.
choices.zh: 它收到了数量极其庞大的捐赠书籍。

choices.text: It did little business because of the unusual cold weather.
choices.zh: 由于异常寒冷的天气,它几乎没有生意。

items.stem: What does Mike Hannon do to help people in his town?

choices.text: Give free meals to the homeless.
choices.zh: 为无家可归者提供免费餐食。

choices.text: Provide shelter for the homeless.
choices.zh: 为无家可归者提供庇护所。

choices.text: Help the vulnerable to cook lunches.
choices.zh: 帮助弱势群体烹饪午餐。

choices.text: Call for change in the local government.
choices.zh: 呼吁地方政府做出改变。

items.stem: What does Mike hope others will do?

choices.text: Strengthen co-operation.
Promote understanding.
Win national support.
Following his example.

items.stem: How are people all over the country responding to what Mike is doing?

choices.text: Spreading news of his deeds.
Writing him thank-you notes.
Following the example he sets.
Sending him hand-made bags.
choices.zh: 给他寄送手工制作的袋子。

items.stem: What were the college students in both groups required to do in the study?

choices.text: To solve word search puzzles.
To send smartphone messages.
To test their eyesight using a phone app.
choices.zh: 使用手机应用程序测试他们的视力。

choices.text: To install some audio equipment in a lab.
choices.zh: 在实验室安装一些音频设备。

items.stem: What do we learn about many of the students in the second test group after the phone rang?

choices.text: They could not go on until the ringing stopped.
choices.zh: 他们无法继续进行,直到铃声停止。

choices.text: They could no longer concentrate on their task.
choices.zh: 他们无法再集中精力完成任务。

choices.text: They grabbed the phone and called back right away.
choices.zh: 他们立即抓起手机回拨。

choices.text: They asked their experimenter to hang up the phone.
choices.zh: 他们要求实验人员挂断电话。

items.stem: According to the passage, what is the most dramatic impact of smartphone use?

choices.text: A rise in emotional problems.
A decline in sports activities.
A reduction in the amount of sleep.
A decline in academic performance.

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest people do?

choices.text: Protect the eyesight of the younger generation.
Take effective measures to raise productivity.
choices.zh: 采取有效措施提高生产力。

choices.text: Realize the disruptive effects of technology.
choices.zh: 认识到技术的破坏性影响。

choices.text: Ensure they have sufficient sleep every day.
choices.zh: 确保他们每天有充足的睡眠。
